title: Patatas Bravas with Spanish Falafel
description: A fusion of Spanish and Middle Eastern flavors in a delicious snack. Crispy falafel and spicy patatas bravas come together in perfect harmony.

ingredients.name: Patatas Bravas
ingredients.amount: 2 large potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: Spanish bravas sauce
ingredients.notes: See notes for homemade bravas sauce ingredients

instructions: Toss the patatas bravas with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until crispy.
While the patatas are baking, heat the Spanish bravas sauce in a saucepan over low heat.
Serve the crispy patatas bravas with the warm bravas sauce, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Optional: Serve with a side of zesty aioli for dipping.
